I made some brownies for Halloween and decided to keep things simple: some plain, and some decorated with vanilla frosting and candy eyes. I used a plant-based brownie mix for both, with extra chocolate chips because, well, why not?

## What I used

For the brownies: **MIGHTYLICIOUS brownie mix**, **Hu Kitchen chocolate chips**, **Melt Organic plant-based butter**, vegan yogurt, water, and organic vanilla extract.

For the decorations: **Pillsbury Creamy Supreme Vanilla Frosting** and **Betty Crocker Candy Eyeballs**.

## A quick note on allergies

The chocolate chips and plant butter contain **coconut**. Hu's chocolate chips also have a shared-equipment warning for **milk and peanuts**. The frosting and candy eyes contain **soy**, and the candy eyes have confectioner's glaze, so I wouldn't label the decorated brownies vegan.

The plain brownies use plant-based ingredients, but these were made in a home kitchen, so I can't guarantee they're free from allergen cross-contact. If you have a serious allergy, please check the original packaging.

Happy Halloween!
